title: EgoBrain-Mini: egocentric video, 32-channel EEG, wrist/arm IMU and audio during everyday actions (40 adults)
description: EgoBrain-Mini is a BIDS conversion of the lightweight release of EgoBrain, a multimodal dataset of 40 adults performing 39 everyday seated actions. It provides synchronised egocentric video, 32-channel EEG (EMOTIV FLEX 2 Gel, 256 Hz), four body-worn IMUs and audio across 1,562 sub-actions (about 63 hours of EEG). The dataset supports research on human action understanding from first-person video and brain activity.
methods_description: Participants sat at a desk and performed everyday actions. A screen prompt named each task, the participant executed it, then clicked end to delimit the sub-action. EEG was recorded with an EMOTIV FLEX 2 Gel headset (32 channels, 256 Hz) with CMS/DRL reference sensors on the earlobes. A GoPro mounted on the headset captured egocentric video (854x480, about 30 fps) and audio. Four IMUs were worn on the wrists and upper arms (left/right wrist and left/right upper arm). IMU sampling rates vary across participants: P0001 and P0022 onward logged at about 200 Hz, whereas P0002 to P0021 logged at about 10 Hz; per-file rates are given by SamplingFrequency in each motion sidecar. The dataset was converted to BIDS by Bruno Aristimunha for NEMAR and EEGDash, with the original EEG values unchanged.
